KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. fupi
   B. nene
   C. zito
   D. pana

   B. Avoid reading anything related to Sarufi 2.4.1 Aina za nomino makundi dhahania.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Sarufi 2.4.1 Aina za nomino makundi dhahania.
